evaluation package

Submodules

evaluation.metrics module

Mathematical and statistical metrics for evaluating Dyna-Q agent learning performance.

Implements evaluation across two distinct phases (Initial Phase 80% vs Stable Phase 20%):

  • Initial Phase:

    1. Steps per episode

    2. Current Cumulative Reward (CCR)

    3. Current Episodic Reward (CER)

    4. Convergence Speed

  • Stable Phase:

    1. Collision Rate

    2. Coefficient of Variation (CV) based on CER

    3. Relative Margin Error (RME) based on CER

    4. Gaussian Normal Distribution parameters based on CER

evaluation.metrics.compute_cer_ci95(cer_std: float, n: int) → float

Compute 95% Confidence Interval half-width margin of error.

Formula (from specification document):

\[CER_{ci95} = 1.96 \times \frac{CER_{std}}{\sqrt{N}}\]
Parameters:

  • cer_std (float) – Standard deviation of CER.

  • n (int) – Sample size (number of episodes N in the stable phase).

Returns:

Half-width margin of error for 95% confidence interval.

Return type:

float

evaluation.metrics.compute_cer_cv(cer_std: float, cer_avg: float) → float

Compute Coefficient of Variation (CV) in percent.

Formula (from specification document):

\[CER_{cv} = \frac{CER_{std}}{|CER_{avg}|} \times 100\%\]
Parameters:

  • cer_std (float) – Standard deviation of CER.

  • cer_avg (float) – Mean of CER.

Returns:

Coefficient of variation expressed as a percentage (%).

Return type:

float

evaluation.metrics.compute_cer_phase_statistics(cer_values: List[float]) → Dict[str, Any]

Compute complete statistical metrics for CER across any learning phase.

Calculates N, CER_avg, CER_std, CER_var, CER_ci95, CI boundaries, CER_cv, and CER_rme.

Parameters:

cer_values (List[float]) – List of episodic rewards from a learning phase.

Returns:

Dictionary containing N, CER_avg, CER_std, CER_var, CER_ci95, CI boundaries, CER_cv, and CER_rme.

Return type:

Dict[str, Any]

evaluation.metrics.compute_cer_rme(cer_ci95: float, cer_avg: float) → float

Compute Relative Margin Error (RME) in percent.

Formula (from specification document):

\[CER_{rme} = \frac{CER_{ci95}}{|CER_{avg}|} \times 100\%\]
Parameters:

  • cer_ci95 (float) – 95% confidence interval margin of error.

  • cer_avg (float) – Mean of CER.

Returns:

Relative margin error expressed as a percentage (%).

Return type:

float

evaluation.metrics.compute_cer_std(cer_values: List[float], cer_avg: float) → float

Compute standard deviation of CER (Cumulative Episodic Reward).

Formula (from specification document):

\[CER_{std} = \sqrt{\frac{1}{N} \sum_{i=1}^N (CER_i - CER_{avg})^2}\]
Parameters:

  • cer_values (List[float]) – List of episodic rewards in the stable phase.

  • cer_avg (float) – Mean of CER in the stable phase.

Returns:

Population standard deviation of CER.

Return type:

float

evaluation.metrics.compute_convergence_metrics(steps_list: List[int], rewards_list: List[float], optimal_steps: int | None = None, window_size: int = 5, tolerance_ratio: float = 0.25, episode_numbers: List[int] | None = None) → Dict[str, Any]

Calculate convergence episode and speed metrics during a learning phase.

Identifies when the agent achieves consistent task performance. An agent is considered converged when moving average steps approach optimal geodesic distance within tolerance_ratio (or stabilizes with low relative variance) for at least window_size consecutive episodes.

Parameters:

  • steps_list (List[int]) – Steps per episode during the phase.

  • rewards_list (List[float]) – Rewards per episode during the phase.

  • optimal_steps (Optional[int], optional) – Geodesic shortest path length.

  • window_size (int, optional) – Sliding window for stability check. Defaults to 5.

  • tolerance_ratio (float, optional) – Permissible margin above optimal. Defaults to 0.25.

  • episode_numbers (Optional[List[int]], optional) – Actual episode numbers in this phase.

Returns:

Convergence details including convergence_episode, episodes_to_converge, moving averages, and convergence status.

Return type:

Dict[str, Any]

evaluation.metrics.compute_gaussian_pdf(x: float, mu: float, sigma: float) → float

Evaluate normal (Gaussian) probability density function f(x).

Formula:

\[f(x) = \frac{1}{\sigma \sqrt{2\pi}} \exp\left(-\frac{1}{2}\left(\frac{x - \mu}{\sigma}\right)^2\right)\]
Parameters:

  • x (float) – Evaluation point.

  • mu (float) – Mean (CER_avg).

  • sigma (float) – Standard deviation (CER_std).

Returns:

Probability density at x.

Return type:

float

evaluation.metrics.compute_stable_phase_statistics(cer_values: List[float]) → Dict[str, Any]

Compute complete statistical metrics for CER across any learning phase.

Calculates N, CER_avg, CER_std, CER_var, CER_ci95, CI boundaries, CER_cv, and CER_rme.

Parameters:

cer_values (List[float]) – List of episodic rewards from a learning phase.

Returns:

Dictionary containing N, CER_avg, CER_std, CER_var, CER_ci95, CI boundaries, CER_cv, and CER_rme.

Return type:

Dict[str, Any]

evaluation.metrics.split_learning_phases(total_episodes: int, initial_phase_ratio: float = 0.8) → Tuple[int, int]

Calculate the number of episodes for the initial phase and stable phase.

Parameters:

  • total_episodes (int) – Total number of learning episodes (N_total).

  • initial_phase_ratio (float, optional) – Proportion for initial phase (0.0 to 1.0). Defaults to 0.8 (80% initial phase, 20% stable phase).

Returns:

(n_initial, n_stable), where n_initial + n_stable == total_episodes.

Return type:

Tuple[int, int]

evaluation.exporter module

CSV and visual report exporter for agent learning evaluation metrics.

Coordinates the computation of all 8 metrics across both Initial Phase (80%) and Stable Phase (20%), exporting each metric into its own designated sub-folder:

reports/[<group_name>/]<experiment_name>/
├── initial_phase/
│   ├── steps_per_episode/
│   ├── current_cumulative_reward/
│   ├── current_episodic_reward/
│   ├── convergence_speed/
│   ├── collision_rate/
│   ├── coefficient_of_variation/
│   ├── relative_margin_error/
│   ├── normal_distribution/
│   └── all_metrics_initial.png
└── stable_phase/
    ├── steps_per_episode/
    ├── current_cumulative_reward/
    ├── current_episodic_reward/
    ├── convergence_speed/
    ├── collision_rate/
    ├── coefficient_of_variation/
    ├── relative_margin_error/
    ├── normal_distribution/
    └── all_metrics_stable.png

Also triggers comparative group evaluations across sibling experiments in: reports/<group_name>/comparison/

evaluation.exporter.export_evaluation_suite(seed_episodes: Dict[int, List[Dict[str, Any]]], optimal_steps_dict: Dict[int, int], experiment_name: str, reports_dir: str = 'reports', initial_phase_ratio: float = 0.8, dpi: int = 300, group_name: str | None = None) → Dict[str, Any]

Execute complete evaluation suite across both Initial Phase and Stable Phase.

Creates the designated directory layout:

reports/[group_name/]<experiment_name>/
├── initial_phase/
│   ├── steps_per_episode/
│   ├── current_cumulative_reward/
│   ├── current_episodic_reward/
│   ├── convergence_speed/
│   ├── collision_rate/
│   ├── coefficient_of_variation/
│   ├── relative_margin_error/
│   ├── normal_distribution/
│   └── all_metrics_initial.png
└── stable_phase/
    ├── steps_per_episode/
    ├── current_cumulative_reward/
    ├── current_episodic_reward/
    ├── convergence_speed/
    ├── collision_rate/
    ├── coefficient_of_variation/
    ├── relative_margin_error/
    ├── normal_distribution/
    └── all_metrics_stable.png

If group_name is provided, also triggers cross-experiment comparison in:

reports/<group_name>/comparison/
├── initial_phase/<metric_subfolder>/
├── stable_phase/<metric_subfolder>/
└── all_metrics_comparison.png
Parameters:

  • seed_episodes (Dict[int, List[Dict[str, Any]]]) – Mapping from seed to list of episode dicts. Each episode dict contains ‘episode’, ‘steps’, ‘reward’, ‘collisions’, ‘status’.

  • optimal_steps_dict (Dict[int, int]) – Optimal geodesic distance per seed.

  • experiment_name (str) – Unique experiment name used as destination directory.

  • reports_dir (str, optional) – Base reports directory. Defaults to “reports”.

  • initial_phase_ratio (float, optional) – Initial phase proportion (default: 0.8).

  • dpi (int, optional) – Plot resolution DPI. Defaults to 300.

  • group_name (Optional[str], optional) – Group name grouping sibling experiments.

Returns:

Export summary containing file paths and aggregated statistics.

Return type:

Dict[str, Any]

evaluation.exporter.export_phase_metrics(phase_dir: str, phase_name: str, phase_slug: str, phase_episodes: Dict[int, List[Dict[str, Any]]], optimal_steps_dict: Dict[int, int], dpi: int = 300) → Dict[str, Any]

Export all 8 metrics (CSV and publication PNG) for a single learning phase.

Each metric is stored in its own sub-folder inside phase_dir: - steps_per_episode/ - current_cumulative_reward/ - current_episodic_reward/ - convergence_speed/ - collision_rate/ - coefficient_of_variation/ - relative_margin_error/ - normal_distribution/ Plus an aggregated 8-panel dashboard: all_metrics_<phase_slug>.png.

Parameters:

  • phase_dir (str) – Destination folder for this phase.

  • phase_name (str) – Human-readable title (e.g. “Initial Phase (80%)”).

  • phase_slug (str) – File slug (e.g. “initial” or “stable”).

  • phase_episodes (Dict[int, List[Dict[str, Any]]]) – Sliced episode logs per seed.

  • optimal_steps_dict (Dict[int, int]) – Optimal geodesic distance per seed.

  • dpi (int, optional) – Image resolution. Defaults to 300.

Returns:

Phase statistics, convergence metrics, and dashboard file path.

Return type:

Dict[str, Any]

evaluation.comparison.merge_and_compare_groups(source_groups: List[str], target_group: str, reports_dir: str = 'reports', experiment_aliases: Dict[str, str] | None = None, filter_experiments: List[str] | None = None, copy_files: bool = False, dpi: int = 300) → Dict[str, Any] | None

Merge multiple experiment groups into a single combined comparison group.

  • copy_files (bool, optional) – If True, physically copies directories instead of creating symlinks. Defaults to False (symlinks).

Returns:

Comparison summary dictionary, or None if failed.

Return type:

Optional[Dict[str, Any]]

Module contents

Evaluation package for Dyna-Q reinforcement learning agents.

Provides comprehensive metric calculation, statistical analysis, and publication-ready visualizations for both the initial learning phase (80%) and the stable convergence phase (20%).

\[CER_{ci95} = 1.96 \times \frac{CER_{std}}{\sqrt{N}}\]
Parameters:

  • n (int) – Sample size (number of episodes N in the stable phase).

Returns:

Half-width margin of error for 95% confidence interval.

Return type:

float

Compute Coefficient of Variation (CV) in percent.

Formula (from specification document):

\[CER_{cv} = \frac{CER_{std}}{|CER_{avg}|} \times 100\%\]
Parameters:

  • cer_std (float) – Standard deviation of CER.

  • cer_avg (float) – Mean of CER.

Returns:

Coefficient of variation expressed as a percentage (%).

Return type:

float

evaluation.compute_cer_rme(cer_ci95: float, cer_avg: float) → float

Compute Relative Margin Error (RME) in percent.

Formula (from specification document):

\[CER_{rme} = \frac{CER_{ci95}}{|CER_{avg}|} \times 100\%\]
Parameters:

  • cer_ci95 (float) – 95% confidence interval margin of error.

  • cer_avg (float) – Mean of CER.

Returns:

Relative margin error expressed as a percentage (%).

Return type:

float

evaluation.compute_cer_std(cer_values: List[float], cer_avg: float) → float

Compute standard deviation of CER (Cumulative Episodic Reward).

Formula (from specification document):

\[CER_{std} = \sqrt{\frac{1}{N} \sum_{i=1}^N (CER_i - CER_{avg})^2}\]
Parameters:

  • cer_values (List[float]) – List of episodic rewards in the stable phase.

  • cer_avg (float) – Mean of CER in the stable phase.

Returns:

Population standard deviation of CER.

Return type:

float

evaluation.compute_convergence_metrics(steps_list: List[int], rewards_list: List[float], optimal_steps: int | None = None, window_size: int = 5, tolerance_ratio: float = 0.25, episode_numbers: List[int] | None = None) → Dict[str, Any]

Calculate convergence episode and speed metrics during a learning phase.

Identifies when the agent achieves consistent task performance. An agent is considered converged when moving average steps approach optimal geodesic distance within tolerance_ratio (or stabilizes with low relative variance) for at least window_size consecutive episodes.

Parameters:

  • steps_list (List[int]) – Steps per episode during the phase.

  • rewards_list (List[float]) – Rewards per episode during the phase.

  • optimal_steps (Optional[int], optional) – Geodesic shortest path length.

  • window_size (int, optional) – Sliding window for stability check. Defaults to 5.

  • tolerance_ratio (float, optional) – Permissible margin above optimal. Defaults to 0.25.

  • episode_numbers (Optional[List[int]], optional) – Actual episode numbers in this phase.

Returns:

Convergence details including convergence_episode, episodes_to_converge, moving averages, and convergence status.

Return type:

Dict[str, Any]

evaluation.compute_gaussian_pdf(x: float, mu: float, sigma: float) → float

Evaluate normal (Gaussian) probability density function f(x).

Formula:

\[f(x) = \frac{1}{\sigma \sqrt{2\pi}} \exp\left(-\frac{1}{2}\left(\frac{x - \mu}{\sigma}\right)^2\right)\]
Parameters:

  • x (float) – Evaluation point.

  • mu (float) – Mean (CER_avg).

  • sigma (float) – Standard deviation (CER_std).

Returns:

Probability density at x.

Return type:

float

evaluation.compute_stable_phase_statistics(cer_values: List[float]) → Dict[str, Any]

Compute complete statistical metrics for CER across any learning phase.

Calculates N, CER_avg, CER_std, CER_var, CER_ci95, CI boundaries, CER_cv, and CER_rme.

Parameters:

cer_values (List[float]) – List of episodic rewards from a learning phase.

Returns:

Dictionary containing N, CER_avg, CER_std, CER_var, CER_ci95, CI boundaries, CER_cv, and CER_rme.

Return type:

Dict[str, Any]

evaluation.export_evaluation_suite(seed_episodes: Dict[int, List[Dict[str, Any]]], optimal_steps_dict: Dict[int, int], experiment_name: str, reports_dir: str = 'reports', initial_phase_ratio: float = 0.8, dpi: int = 300, group_name: str | None = None) → Dict[str, Any]

Execute complete evaluation suite across both Initial Phase and Stable Phase.

Creates the designated directory layout:

reports/[group_name/]<experiment_name>/
├── initial_phase/
│   ├── steps_per_episode/
│   ├── current_cumulative_reward/
│   ├── current_episodic_reward/
│   ├── convergence_speed/
│   ├── collision_rate/
│   ├── coefficient_of_variation/
│   ├── relative_margin_error/
│   ├── normal_distribution/
│   └── all_metrics_initial.png
└── stable_phase/
    ├── steps_per_episode/
    ├── current_cumulative_reward/
    ├── current_episodic_reward/
    ├── convergence_speed/
    ├── collision_rate/
    ├── coefficient_of_variation/
    ├── relative_margin_error/
    ├── normal_distribution/
    └── all_metrics_stable.png

If group_name is provided, also triggers cross-experiment comparison in:

reports/<group_name>/comparison/
├── initial_phase/<metric_subfolder>/
├── stable_phase/<metric_subfolder>/
└── all_metrics_comparison.png
Parameters:

  • seed_episodes (Dict[int, List[Dict[str, Any]]]) – Mapping from seed to list of episode dicts. Each episode dict contains ‘episode’, ‘steps’, ‘reward’, ‘collisions’, ‘status’.

  • optimal_steps_dict (Dict[int, int]) – Optimal geodesic distance per seed.

  • experiment_name (str) – Unique experiment name used as destination directory.

  • reports_dir (str, optional) – Base reports directory. Defaults to “reports”.

  • initial_phase_ratio (float, optional) – Initial phase proportion (default: 0.8).

  • dpi (int, optional) – Plot resolution DPI. Defaults to 300.

  • group_name (Optional[str], optional) – Group name grouping sibling experiments.

Returns:

Export summary containing file paths and aggregated statistics.

Return type:

Dict[str, Any]

evaluation.generate_group_comparison(reports_dir: str, group_name: str, dpi: int = 300) → Dict[str, Any] | None

Generate comparative CSVs and PNG figures across all experiments in a group.

Creates full comparisons for both Initial Phase and Stable Phase in:

reports/<group_name>/comparison/
├── initial_phase/
│   ├── steps_per_episode/
│   ├── current_cumulative_reward/
│   ├── current_episodic_reward/
│   ├── convergence_speed/
│   ├── collision_rate/
│   ├── coefficient_of_variation/
│   ├── relative_margin_error/
│   ├── normal_distribution/
│   └── all_metrics_comparison_initial.png
├── stable_phase/
│   ├── steps_per_episode/
│   ├── current_cumulative_reward/
│   ├── current_episodic_reward/
│   ├── convergence_speed/
│   ├── collision_rate/
│   ├── coefficient_of_variation/
│   ├── relative_margin_error/
│   ├── normal_distribution/
│   └── all_metrics_comparison_stable.png
└── all_metrics_comparison.png (Executive Master Dashboard)
Parameters:

  • reports_dir (str) – Base reports directory.

  • group_name (str) – Name of the experiment group.

  • dpi (int, optional) – Image resolution DPI. Defaults to 300.

Returns:

Summary of generated comparison reports, or None if skipped.

Return type:

Optional[Dict[str, Any]]

evaluation.merge_and_compare_groups(source_groups: List[str], target_group: str, reports_dir: str = 'reports', experiment_aliases: Dict[str, str] | None = None, filter_experiments: List[str] | None = None, copy_files: bool = False, dpi: int = 300) → Dict[str, Any] | None

Merge multiple experiment groups into a single combined comparison group.

Creates links (or copies) of individual experiment sub-folders from multiple source groups into reports/<target_group>/, and triggers the full cross-experiment comparison suite across all 8 metrics for both Initial Phase and Stable Phase.

Parameters:

  • source_groups (List[str]) – List of group folder names in reports/.

  • target_group (str) – Name for the new merged comparison group folder.

  • reports_dir (str, optional) – Base reports directory. Defaults to “reports”.

  • experiment_aliases (Optional[Dict[str, str]], optional) – Custom display names mapping from original experiment folder names to friendly names.

  • filter_experiments (Optional[List[str]], optional) – Specific experiment names to include (omits any other experiments found in the groups).

  • copy_files (bool, optional) – If True, physically copies directories instead of creating symlinks. Defaults to False (symlinks).

  • dpi (int, optional) – Image resolution DPI. Defaults to 300.

Returns:

Comparison summary dictionary, or None if failed.

Return type:

Optional[Dict[str, Any]]
